checks.fixture: Own asymmetric RGB uint8 PIL image, 300x400 or larger
assertions: ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1.transforms() returns finite float32 [3,224,224]

checks.fixture: Own labels ['oak','maple','oak','birch']; IDs ['2','10','1']; fixed train/valid index lists
assertions: One persisted bijection label<->index across splits
No overlapping IDs or duplicate image identity across splits
Join predictions by actual IDs and reorder to reference IDs, not range(1,N+1)

checks.fixture: Tiny own Conv+BatchNorm backbone and Linear head, same initialization snapshots; synthetic inputs/targets; SGD momentum0 weight_decay0
assertions: Frozen backbone requires_grad=False AND eval(); optimizer only head; one update changes head but not backbone parameters or BN running_mean/running_var/num_batches_tracked
Negative control requires_grad=False with backbone.train() still changes BN buffers
Fine-tune explicitly unfreezes selected backbone parameters; optimizer group IDs disjoint and union equals selected trainable IDs
Nonzero-gradient parameters in backbone and head change after one update; frozen parameters remain identical
Validation eval + no_grad changes neither model parameters nor buffers
mean cross entropy equals (log(3/2)+log(4/3))/2 = log(2)/2 within 1e-12
argmax accuracy=1; softmax rows sum1 within 1e-12
Dogs export all120 probabilities and original sample_submission column order; no argmax-only export
